title: "Ashish Tiwari – Animint Gallery"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
dt <- read.csv("meta.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table table-striped">')
cat('<thead><tr>
<th>Project</th>
<th>Live Demo</th>
<th>Source Code</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){

  repo <- dt$viz_owner_repo[i]
  title <- dt$title[i]
  source_url <- dt$source[i]

  cat("<tr>")
  cat("<td><b>", title, "</b></td>")
  cat('<td><a class="btn btn-success btn-sm" target="_blank" href="https://',
      repo, '">Open Demo</a></td>', sep="")
  cat('<td><a target="_blank" href="', source_url, '">View Code</a></td>', sep="")
  cat("</tr>")
}

cat("</tbody></table>")
```
